# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
Personal website for Alex Lutz hosted on GitHub Pages at alexinslc.com.

## Tech Stack
- HTML5, CSS (Tailwind via CDN), vanilla JavaScript
- Static site served via GitHub Pages
- Uses CNAME for custom domain

## Structure
- `index.html` - Single-page portfolio site
- Favicon and PWA assets (icons, manifest)

## Guidelines
- Keep it minimal and clean
- Mobile-responsive design
- No build step required - edit HTML directly
- Test locally with any static server (e.g., `python3 -m http.server`)
